item.text:
Created the Rust migration in `/output` with root entry [test1.rs](/output/test1.rs), Cargo manifest [Cargo.toml](/output/Cargo.toml), and moduleized library code under [src/lib.rs](/output/src/lib.rs), [src/args.rs](/output/src/args.rs), [src/geometry.rs](/output/src/geometry.rs), and [src/triangulation.rs](/output/src/triangulation.rs). It uses only `std`, parses args via `std::env::args()`, preserves the C++ default of `n = 1`, and emits indices with the same trailing-space/no-newline formatting as `std::cout`.

Builds succeeded with both `cargo build --release` and `rustc --edition 2021 test1.rs`. Executables are available at [target/release/test1](/output/target/release/test1) and [test1](/output/test1). I verified the Rust output matches the reference C++ binary for `n=1..50` and for the checked `atoi`-style cases `0`, `-1`, `foo`, `12abc`, `+7`, `"  5"`, and `--3`.
